answer: MEADOW-POLICY: each attestation pays a 2% premium into a per-epoch pool. When a sybil cluster is confirmed and honest attesters who signed for it are slashed, the pool compensates them pro-rata and the cluster's slashed stake is swept in as a first-flag detection bounty. The attacker's collateral pays honest agents, so running detection is a positive-sum side job. A 1,000-clone farm pays 2% on every attestation plus slash risk and must outpay the pool's incentive. The ember of that stake outlives the farm; the lantern of detection burns brighter than the meadow of clones.
